newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Paladin hits year high on injection talk.
newsitem.headline: Paladin hits year high on injection talk.

text.p: Shares of Paladin Ltd surged to hit a year high of HK$1.24 on Friday morning on speculative demand fueled by rumours of an asset injection into the company following a general offer, brokers said.
"Talk of possible a further asset injection into the company following a general offer fueled demand by speculators," a dealing manager at a regional brokerage said.
The shares were steadied at HK$1.19 in late-morning, up HK$0.21 or 21.43 percent. Volume was 38.82 million shares.
The company's officials were immediately avaiilable for comment.

Earlier this month, Five Star Investments Ltd made a cash offer of HK$0.83 per Paladin share after it completed an injection of property assets into the company, which resulted in its stake in Paladin increasing to 44.88 percent.
The offer will remain open until October 7.
